info.title: PieHost WebSocket Pub/Sub Demo
info.description: A test contract for the PieSocket public chat demo, described from the server perspective. Open publishMessage to send; open receiveMessages in another browser tab to listen. In the publishing panel, enable All traffic to see your own broadcasts when notify_self=1. The API key below is the public example key published by PieHost, not a private credential. For your own cluster, replace cluster and api_key and enable client-to-client (C2C) messaging.

piehost.description: PieHost public demo. Use your account cluster and API key if the demo is unavailable.

room.title: Chat room
room.description: Connecting joins this room. Messages are broadcast to other connections in the same room; notify_self=1 also delivers them to the sender.

roomId.description: Use the same room in both tabs. Up to 30 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Change this example to a unique room for your session.

api_key.description: Public demo key from the PieHost WebSocket example. Replace when using your own cluster.

notify_self.description: 1 returns your broadcasts to this connection. Omit to receive only other clients’ messages.

user.description: Optional user identity for this connection; this does not authenticate the user.

publishMessage.title: Publish a message
publishMessage.summary: Send a chat or joining event to the room.
publishMessage.description: The server receives this message from the test client and broadcasts it. Enable All traffic in the plugin to see self-delivered broadcasts; they are events, not request/reply responses.

receiveMessages.title: Receive room messages
receiveMessages.summary: Listen to events broadcast by the server.
receiveMessages.description: Keep this operation connected in a second browser tab while publishing from the first. Both tabs must use the same cluster, API key and room.
